answer: Use smart-lock access-log proof with owner countersign as the entry test. A smart lock signs its access log showing the identity's key opening a real door at least once a week. A farm needs one installed lock per copy, and a log with no physical entries is an empty history. The prism is cheap for one human-backed agent and ruinous in bulk: every extra identity adds another wharf to the bill, so the oasis a ring can net per epoch drops below zero past a dozen copies.
